_hinweis: Content for /programa (src/pages/kursinhalte.astro, src/pages/kursinhalte/[level].astro, src/components/KursProgression.astro) and the lesson-plan generator (src/lib/stundenplan.js, which links each grammar line to a topic page by the patterns in GRAMMAR_RULES, so keep the wording of a grammar line close to the topic's name). Everything here is our own, written from the CEFR can-do descriptors. Never copy from coursebooks or from the Plan Curricular: no unit titles, no tables of contents, no texts. `lehrwerke` would name coursebook series only ("goes with"), without a level after the name; the lists are empty until Edgar decides whether to name any (scripts/check-lehrwerk-leak.mjs fails the build on series + level). To add a level: insert an object in `niveaus` (order = order on the page and in the timeline); the id becomes the URL (/programa/<id>). `pruefung` from A2.2 (CIPLE, DEPLE, DIPLE, DAPLE; see docs/content-plan.md §2): name the exam and the skill, never a task number, a timing or a word count, because those facts are unverified until the exam items check them. `selbstcheck`: exactly 5 sentences describing what a learner can do BEFORE this level.

probestunde._hinweis: Empty = no trial-lesson button (there is no booking page yet). Once there is one, put its path here, e.g. "/probestunde". {niveau} is replaced by the level.
